svg.text: the Phase 1 core — a games model that has not painted itself into a corner
item_uid merge hint, INDEXED not unique
item_type 'game' — CHECKed. The whole door-open affordance
playtime_minutes INT NOT NULL — zero is a real value
merged_into Phase 4 merge, never rewrites keys
Vault — NOT in the library file
never backed up with the library, never synced
XDG cache — NOT in the library file
disposable, refetchable, OS may delete it
keeps the backed-up file small enough to back up

THE DOOR-OPEN AFFORDANCE IS TWO DECISIONS: item_type exists and is CHECKed to 'game', and the table is not called games. Nothing else is generalised. Game facts live on the item; there is no typed extension and no generic progress, because there is no second type to separate them from.
effective_status is NOT stored. It is derived on read: status_manual ?? derive(playtime_minutes, capabilities).
KEY violet = the item · blue = sync bookkeeping · grey = local-only, never syncs · red = deliberately OUTSIDE the library file
library.db — ONE FILE, and the promise is that it stays one
Phase 1 games schema. Credentials and art live outside the file.
